passage:
Tim's school bag was always heavy. It had textbooks, notebooks, old test papers, two water bottles, and things he did not remember putting inside.
One day, his shoulder hurt so much that the nurse checked his bag. She found a book from last semester, three broken pens, and a toy car.
Tim was embarrassed. The nurse helped him make a simple plan. Every Friday, he had to empty his bag and put back only what he needed.
After two weeks, his bag became much lighter. He also stopped losing homework because he knew where things were.
Tim learned that carrying too much is not only a problem for the body. It can also make the mind feel tired.
